scope: Local Node/V8, cached WASM module with a fresh WASI instance per conversion, independent agile DOCX fixture with its declared KDF. 2 warm-up conversions and 10 measured samples per variant; not a cross-device browser benchmark.
sourceStage: First-stage source after dependency sharing and Binaryen convergence, before parser and ASCII case-conversion optimizations. Compact crypto backends were not adopted.
